name: Tourist Guide Certification Scheme
benefit:
##### ***Reimbursement of Fees***

- Reimbursement of the fee paid by the participant for the Incredible India Tourist Facilitator (Basic) Certification Programme (IITF Basic) conducted by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
- SC/ST category candidates are already exempted from payment of registration fees under the IITF programme and therefore are not eligible for reimbursement under th
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a person of Goan domicile. - The applicant must be between 18 and 40 years of age. - The applicant must have passed 10 + 2 (or equivalent) examination from any recognised board in India. - The applicant must have successfully completed the IITF (Basic) Certification Programme of the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. - The applicant must not belong to SC/ST category for claiming reimbursement (as these categories are already fee-exempt under IITF). - The applicant must register with the Department of Tourism, Goa after completion of the Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum to be recognised as a certified guide. - Existing tourist guides registered with DOT before the publication of this scheme are eligible only for the sponsored Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum.
